metadata.title: Microsoft Is Off Its Record High. Next Week Could See the Stock Reignited.<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Microsoft Is Off Its Record High. Next Week Could See the Stock Reignited.
Microsoft had emerged as one of the companies Wall Street expected to come out on top in the artificial-intelligence monetization race. But that was before the AI trade was engulfed by midterm election worries and the uncertainty over what’s taking place at Nvidia and with CEO Jensen Huang.
